listings_without_bearer_token.detail: missing bearer token - log in at POST /auth/login first

api_key_as_query_param.detail: send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter

logout_response.note: tokens are stateless; discard them client side

findings.impact: Refresh token flow required much sooner than documented
Code relying on response.token will always get undefined
Code displaying user.name will show undefined

findings.documented: Append API key as query parameter: ?api_key=IVY26-XXXX
findings.actual: API key must be sent in X-API-Key request header, not as query parameter. Error: "send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter"
findings.how_found: sent api_key as query param, received error
findings.impact: All documented curl examples using ?api_key= will fail

findings.documented: Invalidates the current token server side
findings.actual: Tokens are stateless: "tokens are stateless; discard them client side"
findings.how_found: called POST /auth/logout and read response note
findings.impact: Tokens cannot be invalidated server-side; logout is client-side only

findings.actual: limit is silently capped at 50; requesting 200 or 999 both return limit=50
findings.how_found: sent limit=200, limit=999, both returned limit=50
findings.impact: Scripts expecting 200 records per page will get only 50; requires 4× more requests

findings.documented: page parameter (1-indexed) controls which page to return
findings.actual: page parameter is silently ignored; pagination requires offset parameter instead
findings.how_found: page=2,limit=2 returned same results as offset=0,limit=2
findings.impact: Page-based iteration misses records beyond page 1

findings.documented: collection response shape: { total, page, page_size, results }
findings.actual: actual shape: { limit, offset, count, total, has_more, results } — has_more and offset instead of page/page_size
findings.impact: Code reading response.page or response.page_size always gets undefined

findings.actual: project_id query parameter is silently ignored (returns full result set)
findings.how_found: ?project_id=P60096 returned same total as unfiltered query
findings.impact: Cannot filter listings by project via API; must do client-side

findings.documented: sort_by=price with order=asc|desc sorts by price
findings.actual: sort_by=price returns identical order for both asc and desc — parameter appears silently ignored
findings.how_found: compared first 5 listing_ids for sort_by=price&order=asc vs desc, got same sequence
findings.impact: Price sorting is unreliable; results are in default insertion order

findings.documented: sort_by=posted_at with order=asc|desc sorts by posting date
findings.actual: sort_by=posted_at returns identical order for both asc and desc — parameter appears silently ignored
findings.how_found: compared first 5 listing_ids for posted_at sort asc vs desc, got same sequence

findings.documented: Timestamps: ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix, everywhere in the API
findings.actual: posted_at has no timezone suffix (e.g. "2026-08-19T10:52:00") — server clock is IST (+05:30) so timestamps are likely IST-local
findings.how_found: inspected posted_at values in listing records, none had Z or +05:30
findings.impact: Timezone-aware date comparisons will be off by 5h30m if treated as UTC

findings.actual: returns 404 Not Found; correct path is GET /v1/listings/{listing_id} (plural)
findings.impact: Code using singular path always gets 404

findings.documented: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}/similar — up to ten comparable listings
findings.impact: "You may also like" feature cannot be implemented

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary — pre-computed aggregates for your city
findings.impact: Analytics/insights screen cannot use this endpoint

findings.how_found: called endpoint directly with valid auth
findings.impact: Favourites/saved feature cannot use this endpoint

findings.documented: rental object has no is_live field in documentation
findings.actual: rental records include is_live boolean field
findings.impact: is_live exists on rentals but is undocumented; can be used for filtering

findings.documented: listing object does not include is_live field
findings.actual: listing records include is_live boolean field (appears to indicate active listings)
findings.impact: is_live allows filtering active vs inactive listings — not documented but critical for Q3 of assignment
